DISCORD_PUBLIC_KEY: PASTE the Public Key from the Discord developer portal, General Information
DISCORD_BOT_TOKEN: PASTE the token from the developer portal, Bot page (posting, /verify, team channels, the Discord tab)
CONSOLE_PASSWORD: PASTE the password that makes the first dashboard admin, and signs in accounts with no password of their own yet
TAB_SYNC_KEY: PASTE a long random string, the same value as the check-in worker's TAB_SYNC_KEY
PHONE_SYNC_KEY: PASTE a long random string, the same value as the phone worker's PHONE_SYNC_KEY
CHECKIN_KEY: PASTE the check-in worker's REGISTRATION_KEY, so registration can mint QR codes
CHECKIN_API: PASTE the check-in worker's address, e.g. https://checkin.scs.andyrew.space, with no trailing slash
VAPID_PUBLIC_KEY: PASTE the public half from npm run vapid
VAPID_PRIVATE_KEY: PASTE the private half from npm run vapid
PUSH_PASSWORD: PASTE the second password, asked for before a push notification goes out and before the other actions an admin ticks
ENCODER_KEY: PASTE a long random string, the same value the video encoder runs with (see ENCODER.md)
SHEETS_WEBHOOK_URL: PASTE the Apps Script web app URL including its ?token=, or leave as is to skip the sheet
EMAIL_API_KEY: PASTE a Resend API key only if the Email Service binding is not set up; otherwise leave as is
GUILD_ID: PASTE a Discord server id only to seed the first server before using the dashboard's Discord tab; otherwise leave as is
ORGANISER_ROLE_ID: PASTE that server's organiser role id, same conditions as GUILD_ID
TURNSTILE_SITE_KEY: PASTE the Turnstile site key (Cloudflare dashboard, Turnstile), or leave both as is to run without the human check
TURNSTILE_SECRET: PASTE the matching Turnstile secret key; the rego form requires the check only while both are set
R2_ACCOUNT_ID: PASTE the Cloudflare account id, or leave the three R2 values as is and uploads keep going through the worker
R2_ACCESS_KEY_ID: PASTE the Access Key ID of an R2 API token with Object Read & Write on the scs-submissions bucket
R2_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY: PASTE that token's Secret Access Key
